details: I have discovered a use for the carapace of the crypt fiend. I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas.$B$BBring me the items I require and I shall fashion for you a suit of armor the likes of which has never before been seen in our world!
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Cryptstalker Spaulders.

9081.name: Bonescythe Sabatons
desc: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Sabatons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sabatons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Cured Rugged Hides, 2 Nexus Crystals and 25 gold pieces.
objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Sabatons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sabatons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Cured Rugged Hides, 2 Nexus Crystals and 25 gold pieces.
details: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
progress: Just bring me the materials and stop wasting my time, $C.
completion: They go on your feet. Say, you haven't been nosing around in Tyr's Hand again, have you?

9105.name: Plagueheart Circlet
desc: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Plagueheart Circlet if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals.
objectives: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Plagueheart Circlet if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals.
details: I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.$B$BAnd I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Plagueheart Circlet.

9129.name: Core of Elements
progress: Truth be told, I use the cores to create Frostfire armor. It is the armor used by the mages battling in Naxxramas. Without you and others like you, we would most definitely be losing this war.$B$BWith that said, bring me more cores and I shall grant you more insignias.
completion: You perform a great service for us, $n. Well done!

9153.name: Under the Shadow
desc: Check your map to find an area under Scourge attack. Go there and damage a necropolis by defeating the Scourge around them. Return 10 of their Necrotic Runes to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Check your map to find an area under Scourge attack. Go there and damage a necropolis by defeating the Scourge around them. Return 10 of their Necrotic Runes to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: The floating necropolises of the Scourge plague the lands of Horde and Alliance alike. Tanaris, the Blasted Lands, Winterspring and the Burning Steppes are blanketed in the shadows of the flying fortresses.
Only through our combined efforts will they be turned away.

The necropolises are supported by magical circles at various points in the invaded areas. We have determined that destroying the mindless hordes that surround these circles will destroy their defenses.
completion: You've done well, $N. Through these incremental defeats, we shall prevail against this renewed Scourge threat.
Rest and recover, but then you must head out to the front again, lest we lose the ground we have gained today.
To aid you in your further battles, we will make some of our special items available to you in trade for more necrotic runes.
progress: It will take time to prevail against this threat. How have you fared, $N?

9201.name: Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion
desc: Deliver 15 Greater Arcane Protection Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Deliver 15 Greater Arcane Protection Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B
details: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.$B$BWork Order AL-1420:$B$B15 Greater Arcane Protection Potions.$B$BAll filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BContract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.$B$B-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn$B
progress: Filling a work order, $C?
completion: <Packmaster Stonebruiser pops open one of the greater arcane protection potions and take a swig.>$B$BWOOT! These pack a kick, baby! A kick I say!

9225.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
desc: For 45 Insignias of the Dawn and 45 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
objectives: For 45 Insignias of the Dawn and 45 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
details: For 45 Insignias of the Dawn and 45 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
progress: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.
completion: Good day, $N. It was a pleasure doing business with you.

9321.name: Major Healing Potion
progress: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major healing potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes.
completion: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.

65601.name: Love Hurts
objectives: Speak with Magar in Orgrimmar.
details:
A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

The demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.

If you trust a blind man to lead you, $N , then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.

Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
completion: Who told you about Krilge? Have you come with any news? You better not be toying with me...

91209.name: Continue Your Training
objectives: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
*Report to Shari Stilwell in Brill
details: Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training.
One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

92457.name: Starving Arcane
objectives: Defeat 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants, and 8 Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
* Seeking Remnant slain (8)
* Saturated Remnant slain (8)
* Mana Echo slain (8)
details: The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.
While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.

92481.name: A Student of the Arcane
objectives: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
*Glowing Recall Crystal (provided)
details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
progress: Greetings, <name>. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
desc: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.

92529.name: Falaath Village
objectives:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.
If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.

92553.name: Restocking the Larders
desc: Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village ...
objectives: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
details: Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village ...

92745.name: Toxic Soil (part 3)
objectives: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.
*Kobold Digger slain (4)
*Riverpaw Miner slain (6)
details: The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.

The Defias have seized the mines of and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.

95697.name: Changing Tastes
objectives: Enter the Excavation Sites in the and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
*Thicket Raptor Meat (4)
details: Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.
Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.
A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.
Up for a job?
progress: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?

96393.name: Old Ironforge Incursion
objectives: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
*Durgen Dirgehammer's Head
details: Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults.
My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard.
Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
progress: What do ye need, citizen?

96825.name: This Fruit Could Bite Back
objectives: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
*Prickly Pear Fruit (Forever) (8)
details: Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
progress: Did you find the fruits?
desc:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.
I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. ...

96873.name: A Pain in the Neck
objectives: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
*Luminous Residue (3)
details: The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.
Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
progress: What do you have for me, <name>?

96897.name: The Cult of the Damned
objectives: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in .
*Dark Neophyte slain (8)
*Dark Enforcer slain (8)
details: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
progress: I have a special disgust for living servants of the scourge. They have the free will to walk away, yet the promise of power and immortality has robbed them of their reason and their morality.

97281.name: A Simmering Storm
objectives: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.

98025.name: WANTED: Jai'vhanel
objectives: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. ...

98289.name: The Great Outdoors (Triggered when any 'The Great Outdoors' quest is completed)

98313.name: For Further Study
objectives: Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

98601.name: A Difficult Path
objectives: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.
*Consecrated Scroll (provided)
details: While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine its of some importance to a paladin like yourself.
Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
progress: Through pain comes resolve.

99129.name: A Man About a Murloc
objectives: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.

99153.name: The One That Got Away
objectives: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
*Glowing Crystal Fragment
details: Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.
Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
progress: Did you find the damned thing?
